t: This is the Hospital of St John and St Elizabeth, a Catholic private hospital in St John's Wood. Several notable people died here. Basil Hume, a Benedictine monk, was Archbishop of Westminster from 1976 and a cardinal from 1977. He died here in 1999. So did the journalist Ian Aitken, political editor of The Guardian from 1975 to 1990. Others include the poet Lascelles Abercrombie, the Dominican historian Bede Jarrett, who founded Blackfriars Priory at Oxford, and the Irish zoologist Jane Stephens, an authority on sponges. The theologian James Moyes also died here.
